preConditions.onFailMessage: Only REJECTED and UNDERWRITER conditions can be migrated
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM stop_factors.stop_factor_condition WHERE result IS NULL OR result NOT IN ('REJECTED', 'UNDERWRITER')

changeSet.sql: -- The CHECK on result of SPR's table has no fixed name and allows APPROVED: drop it by column DO $$ DECLARE c RECORD; BEGIN FOR c IN SELECT con.conname FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = con.conrelid AND a.attnum = ANY (con.conkey) WHERE con.conrelid = 'stop_factors.stop_factor_condition'::regclass AND con.contype = 'c' AND cardinality(con.conkey) = 1 AND a.attname = 'result' LOOP EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE stop_factors.stop_factor_condition DROP CONSTRAINT %I', c.conname); END LOOP; END $$;

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX stop_factors.ux_stop_factor_condition_result; ALTER TABLE stop_factors.stop_factor_condition DROP CONSTRAINT ck_stop_factor_condition_value_to, DROP CONSTRAINT ck_stop_factor_condition_operator, DROP CONSTRAINT ck_stop_factor_condition_result, ALTER COLUMN result DROP NOT NULL, DROP COLUMN value_to, DROP COLUMN operator, ADD CHECK (result IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'UNDERWRITER'));
